constraints.name: min_total_inflow_H1
constraints.description: Lower bound on the total realized inflow into downstream hydro H1 (id 1). Total inflow = incremental z_inflow(1) + upstream H0 (id 0) turbine + spillage at each block. The bound is above H1's standalone incremental inflow in every stage, so the upstream cascade release columns are load-bearing for a slack-free solve.
